notes.title: Updates for your next sale
items: Big uploads now split lots correctly at white divider sheets, and smaller uploads process faster (lots run in parallel).
Add photos to CT Seller now updates photos you changed, like the AI white-background cover. The new Replace photos on CT Seller button refreshes all photos on the listing.
Set reserve works again and sends your reserve to CT Seller, including listings already posted.
Standard description (Account → Standard description) adds the same line to every listing, like 'Reserve is $5'. Sales can override it, and Add to unposted applies it to lots not yet posted.
Listing descriptions use more varied openers, and titles put the brand at the end unless it's the main search term.
